name: Overview
description: GeoJSON geometry tour, extruded solid, live USGS earthquakes, Celestrak crewed stations.

name: Earth → Mars
description: Directed Earth → Mars transfer in the flight layout.

name: Mars launch windows
description: Saved Earth → Mars porkchop studies, 2026 and 2028.

name: Earth → Venus → Mars
description: Directed 2034 Venus gravity assist to Mars: guidance burns, close-in flyby, SOI-coloured trail.

name: LEO Hohmann transfer
description: Cowell-propagated 500 → 800 km Hohmann transfer with a coasting reference; covariance and 3σ ellipsoids, plots, Δv budget, CSV/CZML/OEM/SPK export.

name: Low lunar orbit
description: Moon-centred 50 km polar orbits: GRGM900C 20×20 mascons against J2 alone; periapsis decay plots.

name: Ground contacts
description: Sun-synchronous LEO over five ground stations: contacts, eclipses and nodes; timeline keyed to the first Svalbard pass.

name: GEO transfer sequence
description: Mission sequence: coast to node, targeted transfer burn, coast, targeted circularization and plane change, drift; segment table.

name: Optimal GEO transfer
description: SQP minimum-Δv LEO → GEO: plane change split between perigee and apogee, against the targeted all-at-apogee baseline.

name: Targeted transfer
description: Differential correction of rough first-guess burns: Hohmann Δv and timing, low-thrust burn duration.

name: Attitude modes
description: LVLH, sun-constrained ground-site tracking and an inertial spinner: body axes and boresights on the globe, sensor angles, AEM export.

name: Differential drag
description: Flat-plate smallsats flying attitude profiles: low-drag vs wing-into-the-flow decay, and a body-frame low-thrust raise.

name: Coverage study
description: Six-imager sun-synchronous constellation from Keplerian elements: sensor footprints, H3 revisit over Europe, global access, a terrain-masked station.

name: Conjunction screening
description: Satellite vs a crossing debris object and the Celestrak visual catalogue: TCA, miss distance, Pc, CDM export.

name: Orbit determination
description: Simulated radar and GNSS tracking of a 450 km satellite: batch least squares with Cd, EKF, single-station fit; residuals, 1σ vs truth error, TDM export.

name: Monte Carlo
description: Targeted 500 → 800 km raise under state, Δv magnitude, pointing and mass dispersions: open vs closed loop statistics, histograms, RSW scatter, trial CSV.
